answer_1.quote: We investigate a new approach to neural abstractive summarization that focuses on producing multiple summary hypotheses ... Our generator produces multiple alternative summaries ...
answer_1.outputs: abstractive summaries (multiple variants of varying lengths)

answer_2.quote: We report R-1, R-2 and R-L F1-scores that respectively measure the overlap of unigrams, bigrams, and longest common subsequences between system and reference summaries.

answer_4.quote: We recruit human evaluators ... annotators are asked to answer three yes-no questions: (a) has the summary successfully convey the main points of the source text? (b) is the summary truthful to the meaning of the original? (c) is the summary grammatical?
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer three yes‑no questions about content coverage, truthfulness, and grammaticality.
